observations: All 30 native pages were visually reviewed: raw versus EMA on 25 drawings at depths 1/3/6 and eight partial cases.
No material overall visual difference between raw and EMA. EMA is a provisional stable-average choice, not a demonstrated quality gain.
Straight/curved strokes, junctions, deliberate gaps, filled rectangle, blank and wide-bar centerlines remain recognizable.
Probe 36 cap closure and probe 38 closed double tracks persist; scene 1 joins and scene 5 local thickening/stray dots persist in both.
No broad gray halos seen in active generated regions. Gray retained on protected side of partial inputs is expected.
D3 and D6 are visually almost identical on these cases.
